note: Ideas for Offload's picture and content. status: new, accepted, building, made. Reject deletes. Add from the desk's Ideas page.

ideas.title: Launch countdown: the calendar fills
ideas.pitch: Eleven films to 16 November, one block dropping into the launch-week calendar per day. The last film is the full week and the app.
frames: Day 11: an empty launch-week calendar, one block drops in.
Each day another block falls and locks, like Tetris.
Day 3: a block cracks and re-drops somewhere free.
Day 1: the week is full and fits.
Offload end card: launch day.

ideas.title: Courtroom series
ideas.pitch: One revision habit on trial each week with the evidence board. Comments vote the verdict before the stamp; the next film reads the verdict.
frames: Siren. The study police make an arrest.
Mugshot of this week's habit, front, then side.
Three charges on the sheet.
Comments vote: guilty or not guilty?
Next episode opens with the verdict read out.

ideas.title: Placement week Tetris, live
ideas.pitch: Students send their rota shape (no names, no hospitals); we drop it into the blockfall calendar and show where study fits.
frames: A student's rota shape appears: shifts only, no names.
Shifts fall into the glass week first.
Lectures drop in next.
Study blocks fill whatever is free.
"Everything fits." Offload end card.

ideas.title: Expectation vs reality, by subject
ideas.pitch: One subject per film: biology, maths, English lit. Same split template, a new joke each time. Easy to batch a week.
frames: Subject title: Biology.
Expectation: two hours of cells.
Reality: forty minutes choosing a pen colour.
Two more pairs, faster.
"A plan that moves when reality happens."

ideas.title: Your term, wrapped
ideas.pitch: End of term, the wrapped cards with the user's own (opt-in) app numbers: blocks moved, sessions done. Only once weekly reports can export them.
frames: "Your term, wrapped."
Card: blocks moved, not missed.
Card: sessions done.
Card: the topic you came back to most.
"See you next term." End card.

ideas.title: Notification from future you
ideas.pitch: A glass notification on the lock screen dated next Thursday: 'You started. It took nine minutes.' Gentle, never about a condition.
frames: Lock screen, 4:12pm, a normal Thursday.
A glass notification: from next Thursday.
"You started. It took nine minutes."
Screen fades to the next block in the calendar.
End card.

ideas.title: Duet-bait quiz
ideas.pitch: A Test-phase card, a three-second countdown, cut before the answer. The answer is the first comment pinned. Uses the user's own uploaded cards only.
frames: A real Test-phase card from the student's own notes.
Three-second countdown.
Cut before the answer.
Pinned comment: the answer, and part two tomorrow.

ideas.title: Founder confession Fridays
ideas.pitch: Hadiqa on camera, one true thirty-second story about building Offload or her own revision. The only film a real face can make.
frames: Hadiqa to camera, handheld, one take.
One true story about building Offload.
One quiet last line.
Text: "Fridays, from the founder."

ideas.title: Satisfying fit loops
ideas.pitch: A ten-second silent loop: a messy week becomes a tidy one. No voice, a trending sound, made for rewatches.
frames: A messy week, ten seconds, no voice.
Blocks slide, snap and settle.
The tidy week, held for two seconds.
Loops back to the mess. Trending sound.

ideas.title: Word rotate hooks
ideas.pitch: 'Revise ___' with the word rotating through subjects, from Magic UI's word rotate. A five-second opener to A/B against the spoken one.
frames: "Revise ___"
The word rotates: biology, maths, English, chemistry.
It lands on "everything".
"Start with one block." A/B against the spoken opener.

ideas.title: LinkedIn: the build log
ideas.pitch: Founder account posts one desk screenshot a week: what the engine made, what flopped, what we changed. Honest numbers from the Numbers page only.
frames: A desk screenshot from this week.
What the engine made.
What flopped, honestly.
What we changed. A question to end.

ideas.title: Stitch-the-habit
ideas.pitch: End a call-out with 'Tag the one who does this.' and a blank exhibit card: viewers stitch with their own Exhibit D.
frames: Call-out hook, then the evidence board.
Exhibits A to C pinned.
A blank Exhibit D card.
"Stitch this with your own Exhibit D."

ideas.title: Real app screens in an iPhone frame
ideas.pitch: Once the screens are final, one clean recording per LIVE feature, framed in glass. Replaces drawn app screens in the product line.
frames: A phone frame on paper.
The app's real Today screen, recorded.
One LIVE feature, in use.
End card.

ideas.title: The app as a person, never
ideas.pitch: Keep the app as an object (a notification, a calendar, a card), never a talking mascot. It keeps the brand calm and the films honest.
frames: Rule card: the app is an object, never a mascot.
Examples: a notification, a calendar, a card.
Never: a talking character.
